systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Division of Health Information Management
systems.tiers: health facilities, public and private; the guidelines say local governments (districts and cities) shall lead its implementation locally and shall access it through dashboards and reports

note: Guidelines of 18 September 2024, captured as an excerpt cut off in section 2.6: they prescribe that local governments shall view the health records system through dashboards, and report no use by, or connection of, any local government office.
